# Chrome Web Store

> > The official marketplace for Chrome extensions, themes, and web applications offering productivity tools, writing assistants, shopping utilities, and browser enhancements.

Chrome Web Store is Google's primary distribution platform for Chrome browser extensions and web applications. It features a curated collection of productivity tools, AI-powered writing assistants, shopping utilities, and sustainability-focused extensions that enhance browsing functionality and user productivity.

## Key Topics

- Chrome extension
- Browser extension
- Productivity tools
- Writing assistant
- Grammar checker
- AI-powered tools
- Shopping assistant
- Price comparison
- Sustainability
- Privacy-focused
- Document editing
- PDF tools
- Translation
- Music identification
- Browser themes

## Core Platform

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com): Chrome Web Store homepage showcasing extensions, themes, and productivity tools

## Writing & Grammar Assistance

- [Grammarly: AI Writing Assistant and Grammar Checker App](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/grammarly-ai-writing-assi/kbfnbcaeplbcioakkpcpgfkobkghlhen): Grammarly AI writing assistant for grammar checking and tone improvement
- [JetBrains Grazie Writing Companion](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/jetbrains-grazie-writing/fonaoompfjljjllgccccgjnhnoghohgc): JetBrains Grazie writing assistant for proofreading and AI-powered text improvement
- [Wordtune: AI Paraphrasing and Grammar Tool](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/wordtune-ai-paraphrasing/nllcnknpjnininklegdoijpljgdjkijc): Wordtune AI extension for paraphrasing, grammar fixing, and writing improvement
- [Jetwriter AI: Reply Emails, Ask Page, Summarize, Fix Grammar, and More](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/jetwriter-ai-reply-emails/pdnenlnelpdomajfejgapbdpmjkfpjkp): Jetwriter AI extension for email writing, summarization, and grammar correction

## Document & Content Tools

- [Adobe Acrobat: PDF edit, convert, sign tools](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/adobe-acrobat-pdf-edit-co/efaidnbmnnnibpcajpcglclefindmkaj): Adobe Acrobat extension for PDF editing, conversion, and document signing
- [Adobe Photoshop](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/adobe-photoshop/kjchkpkjpiloipaonppkmepcbhcncedo): Adobe Photoshop web extension for image editing and background removal
- [Google Translate](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/google-translate/aapbdbdomjkkjkaonfhkkikfgjllcleb): Google Translate extension for viewing translations while browsing the web
- [Shazam: Find song names from your browser](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/shazam-find-song-names-fr/mmioliijnhnoblpgimnlajmefafdfilb): Shazam extension for identifying music and searching lyrics from Chrome

## Shopping & Sustainability

- [Faircado - Second hand shopping](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/faircado-second-hand-shop/gngckpdhcngilcedefiiiapkhocojghm): Faircado extension for sustainable second-hand shopping and price comparison
- [Beni - Find it Secondhand](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/beni-find-it-secondhand/efdgbhncnligcbloejoaemnfhjihkccj): Beni extension for secondhand shopping and sustainable resale marketplace
- [Clearya](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/clearya/imenjneiobjaiopidanhnejjjaifdhcf): Clearya extension for nontoxic shopping with ingredient and product safety checks
- [Ecosia - The search engine that plants trees](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ecosia-the-search-engine/eedlgdlajadkbbjoobobefphmfkcchfk): Ecosia extension setting search engine to plant trees with every search

## Browser Utilities & Wellness

- [Click and Clean](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/click-and-clean/mgngmngjioknlgjjaiiamcdbahombpfb): Click and Clean extension for quickly deleting browsing data and cache
- [Pebble - Digital Carbon Emissions Calculator](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pebble-digital-carbon-emi/oeamjgnkoelgkegbphiminanlbegaaga): Pebble extension calculating digital carbon emissions and environmental impact
- [Earth View from Google Earth](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/earth-view-from-google-ea/bhloflhklmhfpedakmangadcdofhnnoh): Google Earth View extension displaying beautiful Earth imagery on new tabs
